scope: Integration of eight approved additions; no blanket certification of the app

soundSpectrograms.originals: 37 existing attributed genuine MP3 recordings, all kept unchanged
claims: No calibrated sound pressure or automatic species certainty
soundSpectrograms.provenance: public/lernen/klangbilder-2026/nachweise.json contains recording and graphic hashes, full durations, sampling and STFT parameters
soundSpectrograms.generation: scripts/generate-sound-spectrograms.py: channel power average, Hann 1024, hop256, peak relative -80..0dB, maximum aggregation above1000 columns
soundSpectrograms.review: Numerical generation plus visual chart inspection; not an independent biological rerecording

communityCases.policy: Reuses exact already checked quiz, claims, original photograph context and source IDs of five ecology profiles. No new biological claims or new check dates.
communityCases.schedule: Monday date boundary Europe/Zurich, five-case rotation, all cases selectable
communityCases.discussion: User writes and accepts rules; submission remains premoderated. No automatic publication or factual seal for learner replies.

legacyCorrection.claims: Two Schwarzwild cases used Panseninhalt/Pansenschweiss. Corrected anatomy term to Magen-/Darminhalt; no newly inferred shooting diagnosis.
legacyCorrection.reviewerEvidence: body_parasite_expansion actually read sources and checked pig/boar comparison; further scans found no identical affected terms outside these cases
